"]]};
let pgs=[],cp=1;
function openPdf(n){const ti=PD[n][0],body=$('#vb');vcur=n;pgs=[];$('#vw').classList.add('on');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';$('#vt').textContent=ti;body.innerHTML='';
 PG[n].forEach((p,i)=>{const im=new Image();im.className='pgi';im.width=p[0];im.height=p[1];im.alt=ti+' – trang '+(i+1);im.src='data:image/jpeg;base64,'+p[2];body.appendChild(im);pgs.push(im)});
 body.scrollTop=0;$('#vs').max=pgs.length;$('#vp').style.display='flex';$('#vn2').innerHTML=pgs.map((_,i)=>'<button data-g="'+(i+1)+'">'+(i+1)+'</button>').join('');setPg(1)}
function setPg(k){cp=k;$('#vs').value=k;$('#vi').textContent=k+' / '+pgs.length;$$('#vn2 button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',+x.dataset.g==k));const a=$('#vn2 .on');a&&a.scrollIntoView({inline:'center',block:'nearest'})}
function goPg(k,sm){k=Math.max(1,Math.min(pgs.length,k));pgs[k-1]&&$('#vb').scrollTo({top:pgs[k-1].offsetTop-8,behavior:sm?'smooth':'auto'});setPg(k)}
$('#vb').addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(!vcur||!pgs.length)return;const v=$('#vb'),y=v.scrollTop+v.clientHeight*.35;let k=1;pgs.forEach((c,i)=>{if(c.offsetTop<=y)k=i+1});if(k!=cp)setPg(k)});
$('#vs').oninput=e=>goPg(+e.target.value);$('#vpp').onclick=()=>goPg(cp-1,1);$('#vnn').onclick=()=>goPg(cp+1,1);$('#vn2').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');b&&goPg(+b.dataset.g,1)};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(!vcur||!pgs.length)return;if(e.key=='ArrowRight'||e.key=='PageDown')goPg(cp+1,1);if(e.key=='ArrowLeft'||e.key=='PageUp')goPg(cp-1,1)});
function closePdf(){vcur=0;pgs=[];$('#vw').classList.remove('on');$('#vp').style.display='none';document.body.style.overflow='';$('#vb').innerHTML=''}
$('#vc').onclick=closePdf;addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key=='Escape'&&vcur)closePdf()});
$('#vd').onclick=async()=>{if(!vcur)return;try{const d=await claude.use('downloads');if(!d)throw 0;await d.save({filename:PD[vcur][1],data:b2u(PD[vcur][2])})}catch(e){if(!e||e.code!='declined')$('#vd').textContent='Không tải được tại đây'}};
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-pdf]');if(b){e.stopPropagation();openPdf(+b.dataset.pdf)}},true);
addEventListener('hashchange',route);route();
$('#fs').onclick=()=>{const n=$('#fn').value.trim(),m=$('#fe').value.trim(),t=$('#fm').value.trim(),st=$('#fst');if(!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(m)||!t){st.textContent='Vui lòng nhập email hợp lệ và nội dung góp ý.';return}
 const a=document.createElement('a');a.href='mailto:thienan.281002.edu@gmail.com?subject='+encodeURIComponent('Góp ý portfolio')+'&body='+encodeURIComponent(t+'\n\n— '+(n||'Ẩn danh')+' ('+m+')');a.click();
 st.textContent='Cảm ơn bạn! Ứng dụng email sẽ mở để gửi góp ý.';init();[0,2,4,7].forEach((k,j)=>setTimeout(()=>play('bell',k,innerWidth/2+j*40,innerHeight*.6),j*110))};
const ph=$('.photo'),fr=$('.frame');ph.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=ph.getBoundingClientRect(),px=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,py=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;fr.style.transform=`rotateY(${px*14}deg) rotateX(${-py*14}deg)`});ph.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>fr.style.transform='');ph.addEventListener('click',e=>{init();play('bell',Math.floor(Math.random()*8),e.clientX,e.clientY);burst(e.clientX,e.clientY,'bell',12)});
</script></body></html>
